'''Mok Shaiz's luxury speeder''' was a [[landspeeder]] used by [[Mok Shaiz]]'s [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]] and was slightly damaged during a [[Chase through Mos Espa|chase]] in the streets of [[Mos Espa]]. It was damaged by [[Drash]], the leader of the [[Mods]], a street gang working for [[Boba Fett]]. She used her [[speeder bike]] to ride her bike over a building before landing on the majordomo's landspeeder. The landspeeder crashed into a stand full of [[meiloorun fruit]]s. Fett and the youths converged on the Majordomo.<ref name="Chapter 3" />
